# AWS User Group Kolkata (AWSUGKOL)

> The official Amazon Web Services User Group in Kolkata, India. An independent, volunteer-led technical community for cloud architects, developers, DevOps engineers, and students — celebrating 10 years in 2026.

## Overview

AWS User Group Kolkata (AWSUGKOL) is the largest AWS-focused community in eastern India, established on 5th August 2016. We organize free meetups, hands-on workshops, certification prep sessions, and the annual AWS Community Day Kolkata. Our mission is to bridge the gap between cloud learning and production-grade deployment for professionals and students.

This is an independent community — not officially affiliated with Amazon Web Services, Inc.

## Key Facts

- **Founded:** 5th August 2016 (10th Anniversary: August 2026)
- **Community Size:** 3,000+ Meetup members, 2,000+ LinkedIn followers
- **Events Hosted:** 80+ technical meetups, workshops, hackathons, and Community Days
- **Location:** Kolkata, West Bengal, India (hybrid: in-person + virtual)
- **Volunteer Program:** 90+ registered volunteers with points-based recognition system
- **Focus Areas:** AWS Cloud Architecture, Serverless (Lambda, ECS, Fargate), GenAI & Amazon Bedrock, DevOps & CDK/IaC, Data Engineering, Security, Cost Optimization

## Notable Events

- **AWS Community Day Kolkata 2025** (April 5, 2025) — Flagship annual conference
- **AWS Kiro Night** (February 2026) — Spec-driven development deep dive
- **AWS re:Invent Recap** (January annually) — Community recaps of AWS re:Invent announcements
- **International Women's Day Meetup** (March annually) — Diversity-focused sessions
- **GenAI/Bedrock Workshops** — Hands-on AI application development

## Technical Topics Covered

Cloud Architecture, Amazon Bedrock, Generative AI, Serverless (Lambda, Step Functions), Containers (ECS, EKS, Fargate), Infrastructure as Code (CDK, CloudFormation), CI/CD & DevOps, Amazon Q Developer, Cost Optimization, Security & IAM, Data Engineering (Redshift, EMR, Glue), API Gateway & Cognito, IoT, 5G & Edge Computing, Kubernetes, Amazon Aurora

## Volunteer Program

The community runs a structured volunteer program (Season 2026) with:
- Points awarded for social engagement, event attendance, speaking, organizing, and recruiting
- Public leaderboard with tier badges (100+, 200+, 300+, 400+, 500+)
- 90+ registered volunteers tracked via the website

## Contact & Engagement

- **Join:** https://www.meetup.com/awsugkol (free membership)
- **Speak:** Reach out via Meetup or LinkedIn to propose a talk
- **Sponsor:** Contact organizers for event sponsorship opportunities
- **Volunteer:** Attend any meetup and express interest to the organizers
